alt.summary: Four onion epidermis cells seen through a light microscope: brick-shaped cells, each with a thin layer of cytoplasm, a large vacuole and a nucleus at one side. Magnification ×100: the drawn length is 25 mm and the actual length is 250 µm. The scale bar is 250 µm.

entry.alt_text: Four onion epidermis cells seen through a light microscope: brick-shaped cells, each with a thin layer of cytoplasm, a large vacuole and a nucleus at one side.
entry.attribution: Our own schematic drawing, made for Jana with AI assistance.

parts.function: The boundary of each cell; the walls make the brick-like pattern.
parts.name: Cell wall

parts.function: A thin layer pressed against the wall by the vacuole.
parts.name: Cytoplasm

parts.function: Fills most of each cell with cell sap.
parts.name: Vacuole

parts.function: One in each cell, pushed to the side by the vacuole.
parts.name: Nucleus

entry.title: Onion epidermis cells
